verdict.rationale: LM Studio's own docs state that you can install and connect MCP servers and use their tools with local models, which is the core of this story. One hands-on community report confirms MCP is usable in the app but describes a rough first experience, with a tool-using task stuck in an infinite loop; this shows reliability issues rather than a missing capability. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of MCP setup and configuration (transport types, tool permissions or approval), and independent corroboration that tool use works reliably.
